# Keep your world ON^{™}

We design, deploy and optimise the engineered energy and temperature solutions that keep your world
on. 

[The sectors we serve][1][Discover our solutions][2]

## Power without pause.

And temperature control and oil-free air without end. That’s what we deliver. Where you need it. For
as long as you need it.

 

[About us][3]

## Trusted for expertise, agility and service

### Design

Our engineers are not just technical experts. They are sector experts too, focused on delivering
smart new ways to make energy and temperature control work harder for you.

### Deploy

From rental to permanent installation, we turn the scale, depth and breadth of our local equipment
inventory into the agility to move at the pace of your business.

### Optimise

We believe in better. From our 24/7 remote management to fuel saving, pioneering new equipment to
cutting emissions, we’re on it, finding new and better ways to improve performance.

From diesel and gas generators, broad range of industrial HVAC, energy storage, oil-free

  ][93]

  running.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### Project Management

Our approach to every project begins with fostering a constant exchange between the applicable API,
Drug Product and Lipid Excipient process development teams involved. Ongoing alignment with
analytical, quality and compliance support allows for faster and more consistent results, regardless
of where your project starts.

* [**Peptides**][175]: End‑to‑end development and manufacturing of complex peptide APIs from
  early-stage to commercial supply.
* [**Injectables**][176]**:** Clinical-to-commercial development and manufacturing of sterile
  injectable drug products, including aseptic fill and finish. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Substance**][177]:** **Scalable** **complex small molecules
  and highly potent compounds from early development through commercial supply. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Product**][178]: Flexible production of complex oral and
  sterile dosage forms, including highly potent compounds, from clinical to commercial supply.
* [**Nanomedicine**][179]:** **Integrated development and manufacturing of lipid excipients and
  nanomedicines, including LNP formulation and scalable delivery systems. 
* [**Lipids**][180]: Specialized development and large-scale manufacturing of high-quality lipid

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

Dispatch

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

Let us help you power on with the #1 home generator in the world.

* [A homeowner and a dealer looking over a phone together next to a Generac home standby generator]

  We’re experts in every technical part and feature of our solutions so you don’t have to be. We’ll
  guide you to the right size generator for your needs.

  With Generac solar power, solar battery storage, and smart home energy management, you can take
  control of your home’s energy—helping to reduce dependence on the grid and support your home
  during outages.
  
  [See Solar Battery Storage ][63]
* [A man using his Generac Power Washer outside on a sunny day.]
  
  Power through chores
  
  From pressure washers to water pumps, support your home and yard with the maintenance tools that
  power through even the toughest jobs.
  
  [Shop Home Maintenance ][64]

From the leader in emergency power and preparedness, Generac offers you a manageable way to guide

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and
frustrating, and there had to be a better way.

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,
and demand was so high that it grew very fast. Through hard work and dedication, GetProspect turned
into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,
send them, and close deals. Our goal is to build a great company with a startup culture where we are
happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

Please, let me know if we can do something even better.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid
emails. I realized that the process of finding and organizing leads was time-consuming and

I had experience building SAAS tools and created MVP in just a couple of months. I worked so great,

into a successful company with customers all over the world.

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,

happy to work and deliver outstanding services that customers will love. We rely on the latest
technologies and trends to bring  innovations to our users.

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

2017
Founded
$59.5M
Raised
a16z
Lead backer
2024
Acquired
SF
Headquarters
The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

#### Golden

#### ComplyAdvantage

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is GPUniq?

GPUniq is a GPU meta-cloud that automatically selects the best GPU for your task, takes regular
snapshots, and switches you to another machine during failures. It offers up to 70% savings compared
to AWS, GCP, and Azure GPU instances.

### How much does GPU rental cost on GPUniq?

GPU rental on GPUniq starts from about $0.05/hour for entry-level cards; flagship data-center GPUs
such as the H100 and H200 rent for a few dollars per hour. Every model page at gpuniq.com/statistics
shows the live minimum and median hourly price with 365-day history. All prices include snapshots,
monitoring, and automatic failover.

### What GPUs are available for rent?

GPUniq offers 70+ GPU models including NVIDIA B200, H200, H100, A100, L40S, the RTX 5090/4090/3090
consumer series, and professional RTX 6000 Ada / RTX A6000 workstation cards. Over 30,000 GPUs are
live in the network; real-time availability per model is published at gpuniq.com/statistics.

### How does automatic failover work?

If a GPU crashes during your task, GPUniq automatically saves your progress via snapshots and
migrates your workload to another available machine. This ensures zero downtime and no data loss for
AI training, rendering, and other compute jobs.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is GPUniq?

GPUniq is a GPU meta-cloud that automatically selects the best GPU for your task, takes regular
snapshots, and switches you to another machine during failures. It offers up to 70% savings compared
to AWS, GCP, and Azure GPU instances.

### How much does GPU rental cost on GPUniq?

GPU rental on GPUniq starts from about $0.05/hour for entry-level cards; flagship data-center GPUs
such as the H100 and H200 rent for a few dollars per hour. Every model page at gpuniq.com/statistics
shows the live minimum and median hourly price with 365-day history. All prices include snapshots,
monitoring, and automatic failover.

### What GPUs are available for rent?

GPUniq offers 70+ GPU models including NVIDIA B200, H200, H100, A100, L40S, the RTX 5090/4090/3090
consumer series, and professional RTX 6000 Ada / RTX A6000 workstation cards. Over 30,000 GPUs are
live in the network; real-time availability per model is published at gpuniq.com/statistics.

### How does automatic failover work?

If a GPU crashes during your task, GPUniq automatically saves your progress via snapshots and
migrates your workload to another available machine. This ensures zero downtime and no data loss for
AI training, rendering, and other compute jobs.

## Testimonials

I have dealt with many vendors over the years and have never had the service like they provide. Make
a phone call, text or email and you get a reply in minutes! Everyone from the service center has
been great!
Municipal Utilities Director in Michigan
We have been a Kraft Power customer for quite a while, since we built our new home 7 years ago.
Recently, your technician, David, worked hard to carefully diagnose a problem. He involved the
Kohler factory, your electricians, and a new controller, and resolved the issue over a few days. He
also kept us well informed of progress all along, and was clearly careful not to waste our money or
your time. It is fair to say, this was one of the best customer support and service experiences we
have ever had. David is highly skilled, conscientious, and easy to work with -- a first-rate
employee, and a credit to Kraft.
Generator Service Customer
When we called your dispatch center to report the outage, your technician called us within a few
minutes and said “I will drop everything and be there in 45 minutes.” When he arrived he had us back
up and running in half an hour. It's comforting to know that we can count on your services to
protect our most vulnerable population in our time of need.
Assisted Living Facility
Your service team is so cooperative and helpful. Every time I call there is a quick response and the
techs assigned to my generator are knowledgeable, courteous and willing to answer my questions.
Generator Service Customer
A technician responded to an email sent Sunday in the faint hope that someone was there to receive
distress calls. I explained that our generator, unbeknownst to us, didn’t carry AC. He came to my
home and met our electrician...problem solved all within an hour’s time!

maintenance needs.

company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and

news, and more.

company status.

Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. ### One architecture. Three doors.

Start anywhere; grow into the others. Beacon's profiled visitors become Base inputs become Graphs
nodes. Value compounds with use — without locking you in.

Kara Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Kara Yolu Taşımacılığı

Turu Global [Lojistik][42] olarak birçok şubemiz ile Avrupa, Türkiye ve Asya ülkeleri arasında kara
yolundan demir yoluna, parsiyel ve komple araç taşımacılığı hizmeti vermekteyiz.

[İletişim][44]
Hava Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Hava Yolu Taşımacılığı

Hava yolu taşımacılığı kapsamında direkt, transit ve cross taşımacılık hizmetlerimiz; Avrupa,
Türkiye ve Asya ülkeleri arasında ihtiyaçlarınız doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler sunmaktadır.
[Detaylı Bilgi][45]
[İletişim][46]
Deniz Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Deniz Yolu Taşımacılığı

Dünya genelinde birçok işletmeye kıtalar arası [lojistik][47] çözümler sunmanın yanı sıra, deniz
taşımacılığında da ihtiyaçlarınız doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler üretmekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][48]
[İletişim][49]
Demir Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Demir Yolu Taşımacılığı

Demir yolu taşımacılığında proje bazlı çalışmalarla birlikte müşterilerimize özel çözüm avantajları
sunmaktayız. Güvenilir ve hata riskini en aza indiren demir yolu taşımacılığında; maliyet, çevresel
performans ve taşıma [mod][50]elleri ile talepler doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler üretmekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][51]
[İletişim][52]
Lider [Lojistik][53]

## Lider Lojistik

[Tedarik zinciri][54] yönetimi kapsamında en üst düzeyde [verimlilik][55] elde etmek amacıyla;
analiz, geliştirme ve süreç iyileştirmeleri için hizmetler sunmaktayız. Ayrıca gerekli fizibilite
çalışmaları ile proje bazlı çözümler gerçekleştirmekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][56]
[İletişim][57]
Sözleşmeli [Lojistik][58]

## Sözleşmeli Lojistik

[Tedarik zinciri][59]nin tasarlanması, planlanması, [depolama][60], ürünlerin taşınması ve
dağıtılması, siparişlerin işlenmesi ve ödemelerin toplanması, envanteri yönetme ve müşteri istekleri
doğrultusunda yönetim hizmetleri sağlamaktayız.
[Detaylı Bilgi][61]
[İletişim][62]
Özel Ürünler

## Özel Ürünler

Özel proje ve çeşitlilik içeren çalışmalar için özel [tedarik zinciri][63] gereklidir. Bu kapsamda
iş yeri taşınması, konserler, fuar etkinlikleri ve ağır [nakliye][64] projeleri gibi kapsamlı
çalışmalarla hizmet vermekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][65]
[İletişim][66]
Inter[mod][67]al

## Intermodal

Yük üzerinde herhangi bir işlem yapılmadan birden fazla taşıma [mod][68]eliyle yükün taşınması
kapsamında hizmet vermekteyiz. Kara yolu-deniz yolu, Kara yolu-hava yolu, deniz yolu-demir yolu gibi
taşıma [mod][69]elleri ile projelere hizmet sağlamaktayız.

## Kara Yolu Taşımacılığı

Turu Global [Lojistik][42] olarak birçok şubemiz ile Avrupa, Türkiye ve Asya ülkeleri arasında kara
yolundan demir yoluna, parsiyel ve komple araç taşımacılığı hizmeti vermekteyiz.

Hava Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Hava Yolu Taşımacılığı

Hava yolu taşımacılığı kapsamında direkt, transit ve cross taşımacılık hizmetlerimiz; Avrupa,
Türkiye ve Asya ülkeleri arasında ihtiyaçlarınız doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler sunmaktadır.

[İletişim][46]
Deniz Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Deniz Yolu Taşımacılığı

Dünya genelinde birçok işletmeye kıtalar arası [lojistik][47] çözümler sunmanın yanı sıra, deniz
taşımacılığında da ihtiyaçlarınız doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler üretmekteyiz.

[İletişim][49]
Demir Yolu Taşımacılığı

## Demir Yolu Taşımacılığı

Demir yolu taşımacılığında proje bazlı çalışmalarla birlikte müşterilerimize özel çözüm avantajları
sunmaktayız. Güvenilir ve hata riskini en aza indiren demir yolu taşımacılığında; maliyet, çevresel
performans ve taşıma [mod][50]elleri ile talepler doğrultusunda kapsamlı çözümler üretmekteyiz.

[İletişim][52]
Lider [Lojistik][53]

## Lider Lojistik

[Tedarik zinciri][54] yönetimi kapsamında en üst düzeyde [verimlilik][55] elde etmek amacıyla;
analiz, geliştirme ve süreç iyileştirmeleri için hizmetler sunmaktayız. Ayrıca gerekli fizibilite
çalışmaları ile proje bazlı çözümler gerçekleştirmekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][56]
[İletişim][57]
Sözleşmeli [Lojistik][58]

## Sözleşmeli Lojistik

[Tedarik zinciri][59]nin tasarlanması, planlanması, [depolama][60], ürünlerin taşınması ve
dağıtılması, siparişlerin işlenmesi ve ödemelerin toplanması, envanteri yönetme ve müşteri istekleri
doğrultusunda yönetim hizmetleri sağlamaktayız.
[Detaylı Bilgi][61]
[İletişim][62]
Özel Ürünler

## Özel Ürünler

Özel proje ve çeşitlilik içeren çalışmalar için özel [tedarik zinciri][63] gereklidir. Bu kapsamda
iş yeri taşınması, konserler, fuar etkinlikleri ve ağır [nakliye][64] projeleri gibi kapsamlı
çalışmalarla hizmet vermekteyiz.
[Detaylı Bilgi][65]
[İletişim][66]
Inter[mod][67]al

## Intermodal

Yük üzerinde herhangi bir işlem yapılmadan birden fazla taşıma [mod][68]eliyle yükün taşınması
kapsamında hizmet vermekteyiz. Kara yolu-deniz yolu, Kara yolu-hava yolu, deniz yolu-demir yolu gibi

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is computing investment different from crypto mining?

Computing investment is about renting computing power for real-world use cases like AI training and
scientific computing. Revenue comes from enterprise clients' leasing fees. This is fundamentally
different from crypto mining — our revenue model is based on real commercial demand and long-term
contracts, not token price fluctuations.

What is the minimum investment threshold?

We offer tiered plans starting from ¥99,000 for the Starter. The Pro plan suits high-net-worth
clients, while the Enterprise plan is customized to your specific needs. All plans provide
transparent return expectations and risk disclosures.

How is my computing asset secured?

All computing equipment is deployed in our T3+ certified data center with 24/7 security, fire
suppression, and climate control systems. We also provide asset insurance, real-time monitoring
dashboards, and regular audit reports. Contracts clearly define asset ownership to ensure your
rights are legally protected.

How are returns calculated and distributed?

Returns are calculated based on the actual rental of your hosted computing resources, accumulated
daily and settled monthly. You can monitor utilization rates, revenue details, and settlement
progress in real-time through your dedicated dashboard. We offer bank transfers, USDT, and other
settlement methods.

Can I visit the data center in person?

Absolutely. We organize regular customer tours where you can see the scale and operational standards
of our super factory firsthand. Professional plan and above customers enjoy complimentary quarterly
visits. Starter plan customers can schedule paid visits. Please contact your account manager in
advance to arrange your trip.

Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

financially viable.

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

with our customers and partners.

Solvang

Storage System installed earlier.

scaling renewable integration.

][14][

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to

## **FAQ**

How It Works
Simple as day! Check out our stuff in the catalog, put all the items you need for a shoot in the
cart, fill the form out and rent away! We will reach you shortly to cover all the details after the
do-our-diligence is done. Rental time starts the moment the gear leaves our hands to yours. Prices
shown are for a 24-hour rental period. Oh, and one more thing — if your shoot location is, say,
physically far from us (like another city) and you're looking for some special rental arrangements,
just give us a shout in advance, and we'll chat it through with you.

Easy peasy! When you're ready to rent gear from us, we'll send you a client form to fill out as we
chat. Important thing, though — equipment is only handed over if that form is filled out in advance.
Simple as that.
Paying? No sweat. We take bank cards, cash, or invoice. Quick heads-up on invoices, though: if you
go that route, you'll need to pay it upfront — before the gear leaves our hands.

Also, we will need some sort of a safety deposit to make sure that everything is sound. Be it your
international passport, ID, driver's license or just plain old cash - we - very humbly - take it
all!
Working Hours
For now we can't really justify hanging at the office for an entire day, so make sure to let us know
when you want to hang with us! We'll be happy to open the door for ya within working hours from
10:00 to 22:00. Additionally, we can open a little earlier or, rather, stay for bit longer so you
can get the stuff you need at the most convenient time (only 20 GEL per hour!). Thanks, mate!
Delivery or Pickup
Delivery is sorted out in advance. All we'll need from you is the exact address — plus any extra
deets if the place is tricky to find. Also, a phone number of the person who'll meet the delivery.
We bring the gear right to your location, but we don't do the heavy lifting upstairs, just so you
know

Or better yet, come over for a nice chat with our peeps and check everything by yourself. Having
troubles setting up cameras or balancing gimbal thingies? We're here for ya!

## Große Herausforderungen brauchen funktionierende Lösungen für Bauwirtschaft und -industrie

Auf die Zeppelin Gruppe ist Verlass: Sie ist ein weltweit tätiger Anbieter integrierter Lösungen für
Bauwirtschaft, Infrastruktur, Energie und Industrie. Mit über 12.000 Mitarbeitenden in 29 Ländern
begleiten wir Projekte entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette: von Beratung und Engineering über
Vertrieb, Vermietung und Anlagenbau bis hin zu Betrieb, Wartung und digitalen Lösungen.

Unsere vier starken Marken bündeln jahrzehntelange Branchenexpertise:

Zeppelin Cat – Baumaschinen und Antriebstechnik von Caterpillar, mit umfassendem Service und
Ersatzteilversorgung. Zeppelin Rental – Flexible Mietlösungen für Maschinen, Geräte und temporäre
Infrastruktur. Zeppelin Power Systems – Zuverlässige Energielösungen für Industrie, Marine und
kritische Infrastruktur. Zeppelin Systems – Engineering und Anlagenbau für die Prozess- und
Schüttgutindustrie.

Technologische Kompetenz, praxisnaher Service und ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz machen die Zeppelin
Gruppe zum verlässlichen Partner für Bau, Energie, Industrie und Anlagenbau – heute und für die
Zukunft.

# Die Zeppelin Gruppe: Baumaschinen, Energie & Infrastrukturlösungen weltweit

# Die Zeppelin Gruppe: Baumaschinen, Energie & Infrastrukturlösungen weltweit

## Große Herausforderungen brauchen funktionierende Lösungen für Bauwirtschaft und -industrie

Auf die Zeppelin Gruppe ist Verlass: Sie ist ein weltweit tätiger Anbieter integrierter Lösungen für
Bauwirtschaft, Infrastruktur, Energie und Industrie. Mit über 12.000 Mitarbeitenden in 29 Ländern
begleiten wir Projekte entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette: von Beratung und Engineering über
Vertrieb, Vermietung und Anlagenbau bis hin zu Betrieb, Wartung und digitalen Lösungen.

Unsere vier starken Marken bündeln jahrzehntelange Branchenexpertise:

Zeppelin Cat – Baumaschinen und Antriebstechnik von Caterpillar, mit umfassendem Service und
Ersatzteilversorgung. Zeppelin Rental – Flexible Mietlösungen für Maschinen, Geräte und temporäre
Infrastruktur. Zeppelin Power Systems – Zuverlässige Energielösungen für Industrie, Marine und
kritische Infrastruktur. Zeppelin Systems – Engineering und Anlagenbau für die Prozess- und
Schüttgutindustrie.

Technologische Kompetenz, praxisnaher Service und ein ganzheitlicher Ansatz machen die Zeppelin
Gruppe zum verlässlichen Partner für Bau, Energie, Industrie und Anlagenbau – heute und für die
Zukunft.

### Geschäftsbericht 2025 der Zeppelin Gruppe

2025 war ein Jahr der Entscheidungen. Der Geschäftsbericht 2025 macht sichtbar, wie Zeppelin seinen
Kurs geschärft und sich in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld weiterentwickelt hat. Er blickt zurück auf
prägende Ereignisse, wie die bauma 2025 und die Akquisition der PEPP Group B.V., und zeigt, welche
strategischen Weichen für die Zukunft gestellt wurden. Entdecken Sie Zahlen, Fakten und zentrale
Meilensteine des Jahres 2025.
